scientific_integrity: All-general graph assertions proved by explicit group enumeration, matrix identities and scalar monotonicity; finite exact-arithmetic tests are corroborative, not substitutes for proof. Existing general movement and replacement definitions credited. Equivalent older specializations remain an originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple undirected regular graphs with one independently moving individual per vertex and common positive fidelity; triangle-free condition is needed only for the exact edge-optimum hierarchy. Replacement-weight statistics alone do not specify fixation probabilities or the evolution of cooperation.
title: Three distinct mobility optima and an exact replacement-matrix law for regular networks
